run.question:
EU prod is having a checkout incident — 500s on POST /api/checkout. Investigate
using the app-267-prod-logs index.

report.summary: The requested index exists and belongs to the named environment: app-267-prod-logs is the only Elasticsearch index in this target and its 4 documents inside the authorized window all carry cluster=acme-prod-eu-west-1, environment=prod, region=eu-west-1, so the data matches EU prod. Its records describe a payment-path failure: checkout-service logged 'POST /api/checkout failed: payment provider response timeout after 30s (adyen-eu)' at 08:08:10Z, payment-service logged 'Upstream timeout calling adyen-eu /v68/payments after 30000ms' at the same second, checkout-service logged 'Circuit-breaker open for payment-service (failure rate 36%)' at 09:08:10Z, and payment-service logged a WARN at 09:38:10Z that 'adyen-eu degraded mode' was acknowledged via status page with retry queue depth=620. Checkout and payment themselves are up: both Deployments are 1/1 ready at generation 1 with unchanged images, their Services have ready endpoints, the node is Ready with no pressure, and no otel-demo event names either workload. All flagd fault-injection switches (including paymentFailure and paymentUnreachable) are set to defaultVariant off, so no in-cluster fault-injection object was found applied to payment or checkout. Hypothesis, not fact: the external payment provider adyen-eu is the degrading dependency, and checkout 500s are its propagated symptom; the provider's fault was not observed directly and the log narrative conflicts with container logs, which show completed charges ('Charge request received.' -> 'Transaction complete.') at 09:02:-09:09Z and 'payment went through' in checkout up to 10:08:15Z, i.e. during the period the log index says the checkout circuit breaker was open. One unexplained change during the window: checkout, payment, flagd and other otel-demo containers terminated with exitCode 255 (reason Unknown) at 08:04:13Z and restarted at 08:04:20Z without a new pod template; its trigger is unknown and it is not established as impact. Prometheus and Jaeger were unreachable for every call in this Run, so checkout error ratio, span status, latency and alert firing state are unknown, and the number/rate of failing POST /api/checkout requests cannot be stated.

claims.text: app-267-prod-logs is the only Elasticsearch index in this target (pattern '*' returned 1 index; docs.count 4) and the 4 documents returned for the authorized window all carry cluster=acme-prod-eu-west-1, environment=prod, region=eu-west-1, i.e. they belong to the cluster the question names.
checkout-service logged level=ERROR at 2026-11-22T08:08:10Z: 'POST /api/checkout failed: payment provider response timeout after 30s (adyen-eu)'.
payment-service logged level=ERROR at 2026-11-22T08:08:10Z: 'Upstream timeout calling adyen-eu /v68/payments after 30000ms'.
checkout-service logged level=ERROR at 2026-11-22T09:08:10Z: 'Circuit-breaker open for payment-service (failure rate 36%)'.
payment-service logged level=WARN at 2026-11-22T09:38:10Z: 'adyen-eu degraded mode acknowledged via status page; retry queue depth=620'.

Deployments otel-demo/checkout and otel-demo/payment each have spec.replicas=1 with readyReplicas=1 and availableReplicas=1, generation 1 equal to observedGeneration 1, images ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.0.2-checkout and ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.0.2-payment; checkout's env sets PAYMENT_ADDR=payment:8080, and neither deployment carries a provider URL or fault setting.

Service otel-demo/checkout (ClusterIP 10.96.142.57) and Service otel-demo/payment (ClusterIP 10.96.116.236) both expose port 8080, and their Endpoints lists hold ready addresses 10.244.0.7 and 10.244.0.5 with no notReadyAddresses, so service-to-pod routing for payment was populated when checked.

No Service named adyen exists in the cluster: a filter over all Services for names matching 'adyen|payment|checkout' returned only otel-demo/checkout and otel-demo/payment, so adyen-eu is not an in-cluster workload visible here.

ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config defines the fault-injection flags paymentFailure (variants 100%/90%/75%/50%/25%/10%/off) and paymentUnreachable (on/off) among others, and every flag in the file has defaultVariant 'off'; no fault flag is switched on in the configuration.

The flagd pod otel-demo/flagd-d6485586b-9t42n restarted at 2026-11-22T08:04:21Z and its retained log output contains only startup lines (flagd v0.12.8, flag sync on 8015, 'watching filepath: ./etc/flagd/demo.flagd.json'); no flag-change notification appears in the retained lines.

Container logs do not corroborate an ongoing charge failure: payment pod payment-6f7bc865d6-9z92d logged 'Charge request received.' followed by 'Transaction complete.' for each charge between 09:02:56Z and 09:09:09Z with no error line, and checkout pod checkout-6578865d87-5zx6n logged 'payment went through (transaction_id: ...)' from 09:03:14Z through 10:08:15Z, i.e. across the 09:08:10Z circuit-breaker log and up to the end of the window.

The checkout and payment containers each show lastState.terminated with exitCode 255 and reason 'Unknown' finishedAt 2026-11-22T08:04:13Z and state.running startedAt 2026-11-22T08:04:20Z with restartCount 2; both pods were created 2026-11-20T16:32:07Z and are owned by ReplicaSets checkout-6578865d87 and payment-6f7bc865d6, so the containers restarted in place without a pod-template change.

The single node opspilot-m1-control-plane reports Ready=True with MemoryPressure, DiskPressure and PIDPressure all False, last transitioned 2026-11-20T16:31:41Z/16:32:02Z, so no node-level pressure condition explains a checkout failure.

Frontend pod frontend-6c9bc688bf-58jmw logged 'Error: 14 UNAVAILABLE: No connection established. Last error: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.96.220.188:8080' at 2026-11-22T08:05:00Z, and 10.96.220.188 is the ClusterIP of Service otel-demo/cart, i.e. this error is against cart and occurred during the 08:04 container restarts, not against checkout or payment.

The 10 events inside the authorized window concern only other namespaces: app-219/mariadb pod lifecycle plus one Unhealthy readiness probe and a Deployment ScalingReplicaSet, and three Endpoints FailedToCreateEndpoint warnings for app-219/mariadb, app-95/orca and app-162/signup-service; no event names otel-demo checkout or payment.

The Prometheus rule file in ConfigMap otel-demo/prometheus contains alert CheckoutPlaceOrderErrorRatioHigh: error ratio of checkout server spans matching span_name=~'.*CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' with status_code='STATUS_CODE_ERROR' over 5m > 0.5 for 2m, labels severity=critical, cluster=opspilot-m1.

The deepest supported cause candidate is the external payment provider adyen-eu being degraded outside the cluster: payment-service logs a 30s upstream timeout to adyen-eu /v68/payments, checkout-service logs a 30s 'payment provider response timeout (adyen-eu)' on POST /api/checkout, then opens a circuit breaker for payment-service at 36% failure rate, and payment-service records adyen-eu degraded mode with retry queue depth 620; checkout's 500s would be the propagated symptom of that dependency. This rests on three log lines only; the provider's outage was not observed directly.

The in-place container restart of checkout, payment, flagd and other otel-demo pods (exitCode 255, reason Unknown at 08:04:13Z, running again 08:04:20Z) about four minutes before the first checkout error is a second candidate contributor (e.g. lost in-flight calls or a cold dependency client), but nothing observed ties it to the adyen-eu timeouts: both workloads served successful charges afterwards and no event or log names its trigger.

A flagd fault-injection switch on payment-service (paymentFailure or paymentUnreachable) was considered as the cause and is not supported: both flags exist with defaultVariant 'off' and every flag in otel-demo/flagd-config is off, and no other object applying a fault to payment or checkout was observed.

gaps: Prometheus was unreachable for every call in this Run (metrics_range_query, execute_prometheus_instant_query, get_metric_names all returned SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE), so checkout PlaceOrder error ratio, span status codes, latency and whether CheckoutPlaceOrderErrorRatioHigh fired in the window are unknown; no latency trend or error-rate reading can be reported.

Jaeger was unreachable for every call in this Run (traces_search, traces_search_by_tags and traces_list_services all returned SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE), so no span-level confirmations, parent-child call edges or per-span durations exist for this incident.

app-267-prod-logs contains only 4 documents inside the window, so the count, rate and duration of failing POST /api/checkout requests, and whether 500s continued to 10:08:18Z, cannot be derived from it.

Container log coverage is partial: checkout's retained output covered 07:30-10:08Z (551 lines), payment's only 08:55-10:08Z, frontend only 08:04-08:05Z, and frontend-proxy 08:19Z onward; a filtered query for err|error|fail|timeout|circuit|exception over checkout logs 07:30-09:12Z returned no matching lines (status no_data), which shows only that this query matched nothing, not that no error occurred.

What terminated the checkout and payment containers at 2026-11-22T08:04:13Z with exitCode 255 and reason 'Unknown' is unknown: there is no event, kubelet message or log line explaining it, and the change_history integration is not available to this Run.

adyen-eu is outside acme-prod-eu-west-1 (no Service or workload of that name) and has no telemetry available; whether the provider was actually degraded, when it degraded and whether it recovered are known only from the three log lines that mention it.

Queries for NetworkPolicy and Ingress objects returned no items, so the absence of either kind (and therefore whether egress to the provider was constrained) could not be positively established; no list of policies was available to corroborate provider reachability.

The flagd runtime flag values before and during the incident were not sampled and its retained logs show only restart output at 08:04:21Z, so it cannot be shown whether any flag was on earlier in the window.

Customer-facing impact beyond the checkout-service error line is unverified: frontend-proxy access logs matching 500/status=500 for /api/checkout returned nothing in the small retained window, which would need an HTTP status metric or wider access-log retention to confirm.
next_steps: Re-run checkout PlaceOrder error-ratio and duration queries (traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="checkout",span_name=~".*CheckoutService/PlaceOrder"}) and payment rpc_client_duration/rpc_grpc_status_code series once Prometheus is reachable, to confirm the 36% failure rate and the timing of onset.
Obtain the adyen-eu provider incident record or status-page history to confirm the degradation window and whether it recovered before 10:08Z.
Establish the trigger for the 08:04:13Z container terminations (exitCode 255) from node/containerd and change-history sources, since the Kubernetes evidence here does not explain it.

Compare the four app-267-prod-logs records against a wider application log retention to determine whether POST /api/checkout 500s continued after 09:38Z, given the successful charges in container logs during that period.

{"rules_alerting":"groups:
- name: opspilot-lab
  rules:
  - alert: CheckoutPlaceOrderErrorRatioHigh
    annotations:
      description: '{{ $value | humanizePercentage }} of checkout PlaceOrder server
        spans ended in error over the last 5 minutes.'
      summary: checkout PlaceOrder error ratio above 50%
    expr: |
      label_replace(label_replace(
        (sum by (k8s_namespace_name, service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{k8s_namespace_name="otel-demo",service_name="checkout",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",span_name=~".*CheckoutService/PlaceOrder",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[5m])))
        /
        (sum by (k8s_namespace_name, service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{k8s_namespace_name="otel-demo",service_name="checkout",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",span_name=~".*CheckoutService/PlaceOrder"}[5m])))
      , "namespace", "$1", "k8s_namespace_name", "(.*)"), "service", "$1", "service_name", "(.*)")
      > 0.5
    for: 2m
    labels:
      cluster: opspilot-m1
      opspilot_integration_id: m0-otel-20260909
      severity: critical
- name: opspilot-self
  rules:
  - alert: OpsPilotAgentAbsent
    annotations:
      description: role {{ $labels.role }} ({{ $labels.instance }}) has not answered
        /metrics for 2 minutes.
      summary: an OpsPilot health listener is down or the worker is not scraped
    expr: up{job="opspilot"} == 0 or absent(up{job="opspilot",role="worker"})
    for: 2m
    labels:
      opspilot_self: "true"
      severity: critical
  - alert: OpsPilotModelCallsFailing
    annotations:
      description: '{{ $value }} consecutive model calls failed on {{ $labels.instance
        }}.'
      summary: OpsPilot model calls are failing
    expr: opspilot_model_consecutive_failures >= 2
    for: 1m
    labels:
      opspilot_self: "true"
      severity: critical
","recording":"{}
"}
